name: Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI (twg)
description: Installs the Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI (twg) for working with Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, JSM, Loom, Trello and the Teamwork Graph from the command line and from AI coding agents

version.description: Version of twg to install. Use 'latest' (current stable release) or a specific version like '1.3.5'. Atlassian blocks versions below a published minimum, so old pins may stop working

installSkills.description: Run 'twg skills install --yes' for the remote user, installing TWG agent skills into ~/.agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills

enableTelemetry.description: Allow twg runtime telemetry. When false (the default), DO_NOT_TRACK=1 and TWG_DISABLE_3P_DATA_TELEMETRY=1 are exported for login shells (/etc/profile.d) and non-interactive bash (BASH_ENV)

persistAuth.description: Symlink ~/.config/twg (credentials, site, settings) to a per-dev-container named volume so 'twg login' survives container rebuilds

configureBrowser.description: Install an xdg-open shim in /usr/local/bin that prefers $BROWSER (e.g. the VS Code browser helper) so 'twg login' opens the OAuth page on your host instead of failing inside the container

github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: This dev container includes `twg`, the Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI, pre-installed and available on the `PATH`. Use it to work with Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, JSM and other Atlassian Cloud products from the command line (run `twg --help` to discover commands, and prefer `--output json` for machine-readable output). Authenticate with `twg login` (interactive) or the `TWG_TOKEN`/`TWG_USER`/`TWG_SITE` environment variables; never ask for, echo or log a token.
